instruction: Create a pivot chart that visualizes the sum of sales by month (Jan, Feb, Mar) across all order IDs.

metadata.explanation: This task requires creating a pivot table with an associated pivot chart. While LibreOffice Calc supports this feature, extracting and verifying pivot table definitions and their charts from .xlsx files programmatically is highly complex and fragile. Marked as infeasible.
